questions.question: Which of these did you actually want changed?

options.label: Default backend to mentracloud zrok (Recommended)
options.description: Document/wire `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL_OVERRIDE=https://mentracloud.share.zrok.io` for dev builds. You'd add it to mobile/.env (I'll provide the exact line); the app then talks to your local cloud via zrok automatically.

options.label: Default backend to LAN IP (port 8002)
options.description: Use `http://<your-LAN-IP>:8002` instead of zrok — faster, no zrok dependency, but device must be on same WiFi as your Mac.

options.label: Add NODE_BINARY to .env so bun ios survives
options.description: Without this, `bun ios` will overwrite ios/.xcode.env.local and the hermes build will break again. You'd add `NODE_BINARY=/Users/hiyabuddy/.nvm/versions/node/v22.14.0/bin/node` to mobile/.env.

options.label: Show resolved URLs in dev overlay
options.description: Add a small dev-only banner showing backend URL + Metro port at startup, so port/URL mismatches are immediately visible.

tool_input.command: grep -n -E 'SUPABASE|EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE|auth\.mentra' app.config.ts 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---"; ls -la .env* 2>&1; echo "---sample---"; cat .env.sample 2>&1 | grep -iE 'supabase|auth' | head -10
